title: fix(pm): the contract-review record reader closes the four review nits of PR #33736
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9D6Ata4zFXZo4ihyDbwSe9K)_
Fixes #33770
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：合并队列守卫读复审记录用的那一个读取器（`contractReviewRecordReading`），把 PR #33736 末轮复审留下的四个 nit 全部收口：自相矛盾的“已关闭”发现、标题折行、几种漏读的 FAIL 写法、几种被误判为 FAIL 的干净文字。
- 为什么改：守卫靠这个读取器判断“同 head 的 PASS 记录是否干净”；前三项是放行方向的漏洞（本该拒的记录会被放行），第四项是误拒（干净记录要重贴）。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `scripts/pm/` 两个文件，不发布任何包；18 条真实复审记录新旧读法逐条一致（9 放行、9 拒绝）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 中 `contractReviewFindingContinues` 与 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_GRADE_NAMED_STATE`（N1/N2 的结构性收紧），其次 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_FAIL_KEYED` / `CONTRACT_REVIEW_FAIL_CELL` 与显式 PASS 行也过 keyed 读法的那一处（N3/N4 与第 2 轮 S1），最后守卫自测里改动的一行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`，预期最后一行 `5287 cases pass`，其中带 `#33770` 的 9 行全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One reader, `contractReviewRecordReading` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (the queue guard and `record-recognisers.mjs` keep reading through that one export; no second parser). Each of the card's four items, from review 6892689104:

1. **N1 — a self-contradicting finding no longer clears.** The round-3 allowance (a full stop closing a bold title, then a new sentence on the same line) is removed from `CONTRACT_REVIEW_GRADE_NAMED_STATE`, and with it the `__` title, the tab and the unpaired closing mark it also took. A grade-carrying finding now reads closed only when the state word ends the line AND the finding ends there: `contractReviewFindingContinues` looks at the next line, and a body under the finding (indented, a lazy continuation, a quoted continuation, a nested bullet) keeps it OPEN. Without that second half the same contradiction would only move to the next line. A finding with a body closes by id alone (`S1: closed.`), which is what `BRIEF_GRADE_LINES` already teaches.
2. **N2 — a title wrapped right after the state word stays open**, bold or plain: the next line is its continuation, read by the same `contractReviewFindingContinues`.
3. **N3 — the FAIL spellings named on the card now read FAIL** beside one PASS line: a FAIL cell under a header row's verdict column (the only piece of table state, `tableVerdictColumn`, reset when the table ends); `Verdict: PASS → FAIL` (also `->`, `⇒`, `⟶`); `Verdict: ~~PASS~~ FAIL`; `Verdict was FAIL`; `verdict is: FAIL`; `Verdict -FAIL`; a mark before the cell's word (`| Verdict | ❌ FAIL |`); key and value in one cell (`| Verdict: FAIL |`); title or lower case in a heading tail (`— Fail`, `— fail`).
4. **N4 — the clean text named on the card reads clean.** The fail-safe idiom is not a verdict word: as a value only hyphenated or as `fails closed` (narrowed in round 2, item 5), and in a heading tail any `fail`/`fails`/`failed` + `closed` when it is not the tail's verdict word (`PASS, prior FAIL closed`). A bare `FAILED` line is no longer a spelling (a bare `FAIL` still is). Fail-closed side kept: `Verdict: FAIL closed`, a `| FAIL closed |` cell and a heading tail opening `FAIL closed` still read FAIL (pinned).

5. **Round 2 (review 6898558527 of this PR, S1, S2 and the nit).**
   - S1: the explicit reader stops at its first word, so the template's own all-caps line `**VERDICT: PASS → FAIL**` (and the ASCII arrow) read as one clean PASS; round 1's arrow reading covered only the keyed spellings, which never saw that line. An explicit PASS line is now ALSO read by `CONTRACT_REVIEW_FAIL_KEYED`, so it states PASS and a FAIL spelling and never clears. Pinned in all-caps, ASCII, bare and quoted forms.
   - S2: round 1 read `must-fix: none` directly over `should-fix: none` (no bullets) as OPEN, because a next line led by a grade with no id did not end the finding. `contractReviewFindingContinues` now ends a finding at any line `CONTRACT_REVIEW_GRADE_NAMED` reads as a finding lead, beside the id-led one; both lines clear, as at base. Pinned with a control: a body under `must-fix: none` still keeps it open.
   - Nit: as a verdict VALUE (the key's, the cell's), only the prose idiom is excused now — hyphenated (`fail-closed`, `fails-closed`, `failed-closed`) or `fails closed` with one space. `Verdict: FAILED closed`, `Verdict: FAILED - closed` and `Verdict: FAIL - closed` read FAIL (pinned).

## Why

Review 6892689104 (PASS on PR #33736's head `38cc292a`, nits only) left N1-N4; ruling B on #33718 collects them on this one checklist card. N1-N3 are the open direction of a gate (a record that contradicts itself, or states FAIL in a form the reader missed, clears beside its one PASS line); N4 is the closed direction (a repost cures it).

## Tests

- New rows in the H43 battery's #33604 block of `check-half-states.mjs --self-test`, nine of them: N1 (nine spellings that must refuse), N2 (two), an N1/N2 control (seven closed findings that end and must clear), N3 (twelve spellings that must read FAIL), N4 (six clean lines that must not), an N4 control (three verdict values that keep reading FAIL, two that never did); round 2: r2 S1 (four explicit PASS-then-FAIL lines, two controls), r2 S2 (three grade-led next lines that end the finding, one body that does not), r2 nit (three values that read FAIL, two idioms that do not).
- **Forced test edits, named:**
  - `check-half-states.mjs`, the `#33604 r3 (review 6892305129)` row: its fifth cell, `- **S1 (should-fix): closed.** Every knock names a key.`, now reads `S1:should-fix|0` (OPEN) instead of clean. That cell pinned the allowance N1 removes; the row's title says so.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, self-test only: the same line leaves the `stateEnds` control (`#33604-r3-CONTROL-closed-that-ends-the-finding-CLEARS`, renamed from `…-or-the-bold-title-CLEARS`) and a new assertion, `⛔ #33770-N1-a-closed-bold-title-with-a-body-after-it-stays-OPEN-and-REFUSES`, pins it and `… closed.** Reopened by this delta.` as refusals through the guard. This is outside the claim's file surface; it is the one pin the guard holds on the removed allowance, so it could not be avoided. Nothing else in that file changes.
- Self-tests at head `e9e17977`: `check-half-states` 5287 cases pass (5278 at base), `check-governed-queue-guard` 535 pass (534 at base), `record-recognisers` 399 pass (this PR does not touch it; `main`'s own change to it moved the count).

<details><summary>Ablations (five, each turned only its own new row red; restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Both through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`, at commit `1ea9e6bf`, blob `f06d1258`:

- Anchor `contractReviewFindingContinues(line, lines[at + 1]) ? undefined : ` (x1 → x0): `check-half-states --self-test` exit 1, `2 of 5284 case(s) failed` — `#33770 N1` (the next-line cells read clean) and `#33770 N2` (`|0,|0`). Restore: blob after = blob at HEAD = `f06d1258`.
- Anchor ` || underVerdictColumn` (x1 → x0): exit 1, `1 of 5284 case(s) failed` — `#33770 N3` (the header-row column cell reads `0`). Restore proven the same way.

Round 2, at commit `af85cdbe`, blob `43d9d99f`, each restored to that blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:

- `--delete` of the line that reads an explicit PASS line with the keyed reader (x1 → x0): `1 of 5287 case(s) failed` — `#33770 r2 S1`.
- `--delete` of ` || CONTRACT_REVIEW_GRADE_NAMED.test(s)` (x1 → x0): `1 of 5287 case(s) failed` — `#33770 r2 S2`.
- `--replacement` of the FAILED value alternative back to round 1's `[ \t-]+closed` lookahead (anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1): `1 of 5287 case(s) failed` — `#33770 r2 nit` (got `0,0,1,0,0`).

</details>

<details><summary>Real records (18), read by the base reader and by this head</summary>

The 17 records review 6892689104 measured plus that record itself, fetched to scratch and read by `contractReviewRecordReading` at base `0ff3b146` and at this head (re-measured after round 2): every one lands on the same side with the same counts. CLEAR (9): 6890432656, 6890532571, 6891083453, 6891576194, 6891542450, 6891987837, 6892490875, 6892612604, 6892689104. REFUSED (9): 6890622635, 6890939010, 6890932729, 6891274033, 6891667603, 6891926185, 6892058186, 6892305129, 6892622399. No real record closes a finding with its grade word and a body, so the N1/N2 narrowing moves none of them.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- New refusals of clean text, on the closed side and by design: a grade-carrying closed finding followed on its line or the next by any body, including a harmless one (`- **S1 (should-fix): closed.** Every knock names a key.`; `S1 (should-fix): closed here.` directly followed, with no blank line, by a plain paragraph line such as `No must-fix.`). The remedy is the taught form, closing by id alone, or a blank line. None of the 18 real records does either.
- Lower-case `fail` anywhere in a heading's tail now reads FAIL (N3 asked for title and lower case); prose in a heading tail that uses the word for something else refuses, `fail-open` included. No real record has a heading tail.
- On a keyed verdict line, an arrow anywhere before a FAIL word now reads FAIL, even late in prose after a PASS value (`Verdict: PASS (an older read -> FAIL)`); and a struck FAIL value reads FAIL (`Verdict: ~~FAIL~~ PASS`). Both refuse clean text on the closed side; a repost cures it.
- As a value, `fails closed` with one space stays excused as the prose idiom, so `Verdict: FAILS closed` reads clean; every other spaced form reads FAIL.
- Still outside the reader, unchanged by this PR: a finding kept open by id alone with no grade word (accepted as N2 of record 6891926185), and anything spelled across a table whose verdict column header is not the first row of the table.

## Verification

- Head `e9e17977`: round-1 fix `1ea9e6bf`, round-2 fix `af85cdbe`, `origin/main` `529ed7d9` merged in (the derivation warned STALE TREE before that merge; no `main` commit since the base touches either file of this PR).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on that head: 48 commands, each run, each `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: `48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. The derivation includes `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`; `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` was run as well (exit 0, 399 cases).
- `skip-changeset`: `scripts/pm/**` only, nothing published.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is not run locally, CI owns that run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
